name: Weakness Revealer
summary: Hitting a monster exposes its weak point to the wielder for the rest of the session.
description: Once it hits a monster, the wielder's later hits treat that monster's weak point as known for the rest of the session (covering every section of a multi-section monster); other characters do not benefit. [Weakness Exploit] applies if the wielder has it (Details CR III p.226, Pop. 12).

name: Main Gauche
summary: Evasion +1 while equipped (does not stack with another Main Gauche or a shield's Evasion bonus).
description: Evasion checks +1 while equipped in either hand, even when attacking with it. Several Main Gauches do not stack, nor does it stack with a shield's Evasion bonus (Details CR III p.226).

name: Executioner's Blade
summary: Each critical hit raises its Power by +5 for the rest of that damage roll (max 100).
description: On a critical hit, the Power for the following roll of that attack is increased by +5; each further critical adds another +5 (up to Power 100). The bonus ends once the damage is totaled (Details CR III p.226, Pop. 14). 1H†: wield one-handed (1H† row) or two-handed (2H row).

description: Every round in which it is used ends with its user losing 5 HP as fixed damage (Details CR III p.227, Pop. 10).

name: Arm Catcher
summary: At Accuracy -2 it can target a weapon: on a hit the weapon is dropped.
description: The wielder may attack the target's weapon with Accuracy -2. On a hit, that weapon is knocked to the ground in addition to normal damage. Against monster data this only works on weapon attacks (not natural ones), and the monster's damage with them is reduced by 4 (Details CR III p.227).

name: Death Scythe
summary: Power 42; pay 5 HP (password in Arcana) to use Power 52 for 1 round.
description: Normally Power 42. Speaking its password in Arcana and paying 5 HP lets it be used at Power 52 for 10 seconds (1 round) (Details CR III p.227, Pop. 14).

description: 1H*: usable in melee or thrown; it counts as the matching category for each attack. As a thrown weapon: range 2 (20m) (CR III p.215). Auto-Return: after being thrown it immediately returns to the thrower's hand.

name: Urgosh
summary: Silvered. With [Dual Wielding] attack twice (slash + pierce); otherwise 2H use gains Extra Damage +5.
description: Silvered. Always held in two hands. A wielder with [Dual Wielding] may attack twice, once with the slashing data and once with the piercing data, as if wielding two 1H weapons. Otherwise it is used as a 2H weapon with either data line and Extra Damage +5 (Details CR III p.227-228, Pop. 10). Choose slashing (2Hᵴ) or piercing (2Hᵱ) data before each Accuracy check.

description: Can only be equipped while the current MP is 2 or more. While equipped, all Magic Power +2; at the end of each of the wielder's turns they suffer 2 points of fixed damage to MP (Details CR III p.229, Pop. 14).

name: Uroboros
summary: Once a day, reroll a Spellcasting check of 9 or less for 10 MP each until the roll is 10+.
description: Once per day, when a Spellcasting check's 2d roll is 9 or less, the wielder may pay 10 MP to reroll, and must keep paying 10 MP and rerolling until the roll is 10 or more, which becomes the result. Stopping early makes the check an automatic failure; spent MP is not refunded (Details CR III p.229, Pop. 14).
